research_question: Does partial-pooling league strength improve xG-free UEFA probabilities over domestic result based naive base, and do prior opponent-adapted UEFA results add genuine out-of-time improvement?

M0.name: NAIVE_DOMESTIC_NORMALIZED_GOALS_BASELINE
M0.data: For each club, strictly earlier same-season domestic results, own scored/conceded and current-league home/away scoring references; shared UEFA training intercept. Goal-rate Poisson, no xG.
M0.constraints: No direct assertion that two domestic league averages imply equal country strengths; an explicit neutral zero-offset assumption is an intentionally naive control, not a verified international scale.
M0.fit_policy: Train-only once, no validation/holdout refit. Shared smoothing k=5 for goal counts, fixed ahead of outcome evaluation.

M1.name: M0_PLUS_PARTIAL_POOLED_INTERLEAGUE_STRENGTH
M1.data: M0 plus 2025/26 UEFA CL+EL earlier match results in training window, country-league effects centered to zero weighted mean, ridge=20 fixed, home advantage separately estimated.
M1.constraints: Ten-league effects are not automatically identifiable on sparse cross-league edges; report per-league degree, held-out unseen leagues and selection bias, refuse output rather than invent effects.
M1.fit_policy: One fit on eligible training matches only; fixed ridge penalty 20; no tuning or holdout-informed coefficient changes.

M2.name: M1_PLUS_PREMATCH_OPPONENT_DEPENDENT_UEFA_FORM
M2.data: M1 plus prior completed UEFA matchday points/game and goals-conceded rates, strength-adjusted opponents only when prior-game opponent effects known at that date. No H2H, no goal-motivation multiplier.
M2.constraints: All UEFA standings and opponent-strength features must be reconstructed before target date and before any same-day results. If source dates cannot be constructed, M2 excluded with reason.
M2.fit_policy: Fixed ridge=20 on three additional standardized coefficients: prior UEFA pts/game gap, prior goals conceded/game gap and capped opponent-strength-average gap; no search or tuning.

metrics.correctness: Probabilities finite in [0,1], 1X2 sums to one, paired identical fixture IDs and no predicted use of final scores.
metrics.inference: Paired signed per-match difference; date-block bootstrap descriptive only with fixed seed 263 and 1000 replicates; small 2-month/single-season holdout bars strong causal or launch claims.

decision_rules.after_preflight: Only one fixed run may be scheduled after all baseline, league graph and predate temporal guards pass.
decision_rules.provenance_requirement: Evidence of historical source publication snapshots or event-time immutable live predictions required separately.
decision_rules.holdout_warning: Jan 2026 32 matches and same-season team selection insufficient alone for cross-season external validity.
decision_rules.if_any_model_missing_features: Stop paired three-way comparison, report blocked model(s); do not silently compare unequal samples.
decision_rules.if_no_future_new_season: Conclude exploratory only; no model promotion.
